Container.Name: automatic-ripping-machine
Container.Overview:
Insert an optical disc (Blu-ray, DVD, CD) and checks to see if it's audio, video (Movie or TV), or data, then rips it.
See: https://b3n.org/automatic-ripping-machine
Run 'lsscsi -g' on the Unraid terminal to find both the block device (/dev/srX) and SCSI generic device (/dev/sgX) for your optical drive.
For NVIDIA GPU hardware transcoding, add '--runtime=nvidia' to Extra Parameters and set your GPU UUID in NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES (under Advanced View).
HandBrake presets: https://handbrake.fr/docs/en/latest/technical/official-presets.html Docker Wiki: https://github.com/automatic-ripping-machine/automatic-ripping-machine/wiki/Docker Docker Troubleshooting: https://github.com/automatic-ripping-machine/automatic-ripping-machine/wiki/Docker-Troubleshooting

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: WebUI port for Automatic Ripping Machine

Config.Name: Music Path
Config.Description: Storage location for ripped audio CDs

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Storage location for ARM configuration files (arm.yaml, apprise.yaml, etc.)

Config.Name: Logs Path
Config.Description: Storage location for ARM log files

Config.Name: Media Path
Config.Description: Storage location for raw and transcoded video rips (Movies/TV)

Config.Name: Optical Drive (Block Device)
Config.Description: Optical drive block device (run 'lsscsi -g' in Unraid terminal to find your drive's /dev/srX path)

Config.Name: Optical Drive (SCSI Generic Device)
Config.Description: Optical drive SCSI generic device required by MakeMKV (run 'lsscsi -g' in Unraid terminal to find your drive's /dev/sgX path)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for ARM inside the container (default 1000)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for ARM inside the container (default 1000)

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Optional: For NVIDIA NVENC hardware transcoding (also add '--runtime=nvidia' to Extra Parameters)

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: Optional: Enter your NVIDIA GPU UUID (e.g. GPU-xxxx) for hardware transcoding (also add '--runtime=nvidia' to Extra Parameters)
